content.text:
I submitted **index 5 (Bi 0.92 / Sb 0.08)**. It had the highest EQE of the three compositions I measured: 1.40e-4 %.

All three merit measurements are used:

| Index | Composition (Bi / Sb) | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.92 / 0.08 | 1.40e-4 |
| 0 | 0.97 / 0.03 | 1.04e-4 |
| 21 | 0.49 / 0.51 | 8.7e-6 |

- **Trend:** Bi-rich compositions did about 16 times better than the 1:1 composition. The most Bi-rich point dropped off again, which suggests the best value is somewhere around 3–15% Sb. I couldn't measure the points in that range to narrow it down, so the true best in the library may be a neighbour of index 5.
- **XRD (3 of 5 scans used, at indices 5, 13 and 21):** Index 5 looks mostly like a Bi-rich bismuth oxide (Bi2O3 / Bi4O7 type) plus a second phase. The 1:1 sample is dominated by a phase that no database structure matches well (best similarity 0.53).
- **Caveat:** Every EQE is very low, around 1e-4 %. The 2.4 eV light is probably at or below the band gap of these oxides, so even the best composition barely responds.
